alerts.title: Overdue creatinine monitoring on TDF
alerts.message: Guidelines require serum creatinine monitoring for patients on TDF-based ART. The patient's last creatinine was 478 days before this visit, over 15 months ago. No creatinine was ordered at today's encounter. TDF can cause renal toxicity, and regular renal function monitoring is essential for early detection of nephrotoxicity. The clinician's plan of routine follow-up with no issues does not include renal monitoring.

evidence.recommended_action: Order serum creatinine and eGFR at this visit to assess TDF renal safety, and establish routine renal monitoring per guideline intervals.

alerts.title: Low-level viremia on DTG-based regimen
alerts.message: Guidelines note that viral load >200 copies/mL is associated with risk of transmission and treatment failure, and that low-level viremia should be monitored. The patient's viral load was 40 copies/mL 113 days before this visit, which is detectable but below the suppression threshold. While on a DTG-based regimen (TLD), this low-level viremia warrants enhanced adherence counseling and repeat viral load testing to confirm whether suppression is achieved or viremia is progressing.

evidence.recommended_action: Repeat viral load testing and provide enhanced adherence counseling; evaluate for potential treatment failure if viremia persists or increases.
